note: Planted inputs for the negative deck build of tests/unit/deck.test.ts (blueprint 11.9 AC-DEL-02 and AC-DEL-07).
A gate nobody has ever seen fire is a gate nobody knows works, so the test copies deck/, bundle/ and
supplied/team-facts.json into a throwaway tree, applies the two plants below to the copies alone, runs the real
deck/build.ts against them and requires a non-zero exit carrying both messages verbatim. Nothing here touches the
repository's own deck source, its fixture or the read-only supplied/ directory.

missing_key.why: A data-fx key the fixture does not carry must stop the build, never render as an empty span on a slide.

placeholder.why: TBD_ is the placeholder marker of supplied/team-facts.json; one reaching a rendered slide must be red.
placeholder.expect: TBD_ placeholder visible in the deck: TBD_AREA_OF_EXPERTISE
